description:
Extend the submitter to produce full PR-ready patches rather than bug reports only. Design: patch generation (git format-patch? branch-and-push?), branch naming, commit attribution, PR body template (what context to include, how to link back to the agent-run that produced the fix without exfiltrating private context), and how the classifier handles multi-file fixes where only some files are upstreamable.

Deliverable: conclusion.md with the PR artifact contract and a go/no-go on whether PR submissions need isolated verification before landing (links to contribution-verification-isolated initiative).
name: pr-fix-artifact-design
title: Design PR-fix artifact type for outbound submissions
